drive-labels.locator: lines 71-71; anchor: rear plates identify a Robotron
drive-labels.excerpt: text: "Danila’s rear plates identify a Robotron K 5601, serial 044713, from VEB Robotron Buchungsmaschinenwerk Karl-Marx-Stadt, and an assembly by Ratan Exports & Industries Ltd. in India. The TEAC board labels read 15532064-00A and 15532092-00A. These small photo labels retain the original print and wear. The cable-obscured country line is typeset. Drive sizes and hidden details remain estimates.",

keyboard-cpu.locator: lines 125-125; anchor: separate narrow controller with a socketed
keyboard-cpu.excerpt: "Danila’s October 12 photos show the broad switch PCB and a separate narrow controller with a socketed UB880D, small DIP logic, discrete components, connector and shield clamp. The model reconstructs clean parts with nominal 2.54 mm IC lead pitch; board dimensions, placement and hidden routing remain estimates. Open the keyboard to separate the controller for inspection. Danila confirms that the installed EPROM came from another board.

keyboard-rom.locator: lines 54-54; anchor: Danila confirms the keyboard EPROM
keyboard-rom.excerpt: Danila confirms the keyboard EPROM came from another board and works; its blue window cover is represented, but its firmware contents are unknown. The S600 emulated reference has not been relabeled as the specimen ROM. Existing comparative motherboard/CRT references retain their credits.
